title: IVG Pro 12 Lemon Lime Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Lemon Lime IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods combine zesty Lemon and Lime for a punchy citrus vape that’s bright and refreshing. It delivers a sharp tang on the inhale, balanced with a clean, crisp finish that lingers on the tastebuds. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 0mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once connected, the system automatically tops up the pod as you vape — no coil replacements or manual refilling needed. The pod and refill together support up to 10,000 puffs per kit depending on your usage. With mesh coil technology for smooth MTL vapour, these pods are designed exclusively for the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
